project_description_summary: Security Engineering Program Assistance (SEPA) repairs at Navy Operational Support Center (NOSC) Orlando, located within the Armed Forces Reserve Center at NSA Orlando, Florida. Following the 2015 terrorist attack at a NOSC in Chattanooga, TN, the Navy evaluated security upgrades at 21 NOSCs. This project provides physical security upgrades to the multi-tenant, multi-story facility including: (1) two new K-rated cantilevered sliding vehicle gates at both Entry Control Points off Dowden Road; (2) two ingress/egress pedestrian turnstiles with CAC card readers; (3) K-rated manual drop arm gate at rear loading dock; (4) K-rated anti-ram cable reinforcement along north perimeter fence; (5) five PTZ CCTV cameras plus one fixed quarterdeck camera with 16-channel DVR; (6) full ACS modernization with Hirsch/Identiv Velocity system and CAC-compatible readers at all exterior doors; (7) fragmentation retention film on all exterior windows and doors; and (8) interior door deadbolt/security hardware additions for shelter-in-place capability. Design-build delivery. BFA (Bowman Foster & Associates) performed site survey in December 2022 as designer of record / engineering subconsultant to the design-build prime.
